text: 查理转身面对你。“你简直疯了！我的族人讲过远方来客的故事，也讲过他们可怕的魔法。他们会惩罚窥探他们的人。”
坚持折返回去救伯纳德，前往154。同意查理的说法，前往155。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 153
text: Charlie rounds on you. “You speak madness! My people tell stories of the Fishers-From-Afar and their terrible magic. They punish those who spy upon them.”
To insist upon circling back to help Bernard, go to 154. To agree with Charlie, go to 155.
